profile.headline: SWE @ Bumble AI Labs
profile.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 20+ years of full-stack experience and a proven track record of leading high-impact, customer-focused engineering initiatives. Trusted engineering partner known for delivering results, earning top performance ratings, and leading teams through ambiguity and scale. Passionate about applied AI, cloud architecture, and building scalable, maintainable systems.

positions.title: Senior Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Selected by engineering leadership to step into a Senior Engineering Manager role reporting to the VP of Engineering, leading 5 engineers across Legal Transcription workflows and SmartDepo, Rev’s acquired transcript summarization product.

In this player/coach role, I managed engineers through 1:1s, performance feedback, career development, prioritization, delivery planning, and day-to-day execution while remaining technically involved across both product areas.

Highlights:

> Led engineering delivery across Legal Transcription workflows and SmartDepo summarization initiatives.
> Partnered with Product and cross-functional stakeholders to plan, unblock, and deliver team-owned initiatives including automatic multi-source media syncing in the transcript editor, Legal transcription back catalog management, and SmartDepo summarization support for non-deposition transcripts.
> Contributed hands-on implementation, debugging, and code reviews across Legal Transcription workflows in C#/.NET and TypeScript and SmartDepo summarization features in Python, MongoDB, and Next.js.
> Supported engineers through technical design, code reviews, prioritization, delivery planning, and execution across two product areas.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Staff Software Engineer across Rev’s Legal transcription business, leading applied AI, workflow automation, full-stack product delivery, and cross-functional technical initiatives.

Highlights:

> Built a Python-based AI automation service for Rev’s Legal transcription business, supporting document conversion, automated speaker labeling, and Q&A labeling workflows and contributing to an estimated $350K annual margin increase.
> Designed and delivered full-stack capabilities for a new Legal order placement platform, spanning frontend workflows, backend services, APIs, data models, and workflow logic, increasing order throughput by 40% and improving business flexibility.
> Partnered with Product, Operations, and speech science stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate AI-augmented transcript workflows, and support controlled production rollouts.
> Co-led development of a live meeting transcription editor, contributing architecture, implementation, and cross-functional technical direction.
> Provided Staff-level technical leadership through design reviews, implementation planning, mentoring, code review, troubleshooting, and coordination across teams.

Technologies and areas: Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript, React, SQL, applied AI, LLM integration, workflow automation, legal transcription systems, APIs, frontend workflows, backend services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Senior Software Engineer on customer-facing product and platform initiatives across checkout, billing, experimentation, and purchase funnel optimization.

Highlights:

> Took ownership of a stalled checkout modernization initiative, completed critical backend and frontend features, and led production rollout for Rev’s customer purchase flow.
> Built customer billing portal capabilities and integrated with Zuora to improve billing workflows and customer self-service.
> Implemented a system-wide GrowthBook integration for feature flagging and experimentation, enabling safer rollouts and faster product iteration across engineering teams.
> Designed and executed purchase funnel experiments to improve conversion and support data-driven product decisions.
> Delivered production features across C#, .NET, TypeScript, React, SQL, services, APIs, and cloud-hosted systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer/Team  Lead
positions.description:
• Led and mentored an Agile team of developers.
• Designed multiple high-availability Kubernetes clusters in AWS to power mission-critical applications.
• Engineered and maintained CI/CD pipelines in Gitlab and Azure DevOps to automate Docker builds, testing and deployment of applications to multiple environments.
• Designed REST APIs to power client-facing applications and integrate various distributed systems.
• Developed front-end applications in Angular and React.
• Developed high-throughput, real-time integration services using C#, .NET, RabbitMQ and Oracle.
• Applied object-oriented design patterns and software development principles to create performant, readable and maintainable code.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed mobile applications for iOS and Android using Xamarin and Apache Cordova.
• Developed web applications in C# and VB.Net that extended the college ERP to handle admissions applications, tuition payments, and other core business functions.
• Developed a JavaScript-based document scanning application that has digitized millions of student and employee records.
• Presented at several industry conferences to share expertise and solutions with other post-secondary institutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed the college course catalog application, which transforms program and course data from the college ERP into searchable web and print versions.
• Developed an event registration application that enabled over 25,000 high school students to experience college for a day.
• Led the implementation of a new Web Content Management System, including template design and content migration.
• Conducted group training sessions for employees on various software systems.
